name: io.github.emazaheri/ios-agent
title: ios-agent
description: Drive a real iPhone or an iOS Simulator with an AI agent, through XCUIAutomation.

environmentVariables.name: IOS_MCP_POLICY__CONFIRM_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Ask before an action that sends, deletes, or pays. Leave it on for a device carrying real accounts.

environmentVariables.name: IOS_MCP_POLICY__ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: The policy gate as a whole: approval, app blocklist, redaction, audit.

environmentVariables.name: IOS_MCP_WDA__BUNDLE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Bundle id of the WebDriverAgent runner. Free Apple IDs cannot sign com.facebook.*, so device builds need their own.

environmentVariables.name: IOS_MCP_SIMULATOR__SHOW_WINDOW
environmentVariables.description: Bring Simulator.app to the front when booting, so a person can watch the agent drive. Set false in CI.
